metric.name: Validation CIDEr-D
metric.scale: Native pycocoevalcap1.2 score, no extra factor100

paired_profile_definition: For each profile, compare to baseline within each fixed encoder+decoder pair (15 pairs=5encoders x3decoders). Delta is profile minus baseline in native CIDEr-D units and best-epoch count. Wins require delta>1e-12. These are single-seed paired descriptive comparisons, not statistical significance tests.
profile_notes: small_hidden changes RNN/LSTM hidden512->256 but keeps embedding512. Transformer small_hidden changes embedding and d_model512->256, while heads8 and FFN2048 stay fixed.
stacked uses2layers; the4extra depth experiments use3or4layers and are excluded from original75 comparisons.
high_dropout uses0.5 instead of0.3. Recurrent built-in dropout remains0; explicit embedding/output dropout is used.
image_layernorm adds normalization after the visual projection; its meaning is not an extra layer in the recurrent stack.

fusion_learning_curve.epoch0_note: Initialization evaluation before fusion updates; transferred prefix model, not a newly trained epoch.
fusion_learning_curve.stopping_note: The run was manually stopped during epoch14; only completed epochs0..13 appear here. Epoch13 is greedy-best; decoding selection later chose epoch11.

caveat: Best-of15 and best-of25 show selected experiment outcomes, not controlled encoder-only/decoder-only causal effects. Device/timing comparisons are not normalized.
